method: Supervisor compared returned visible-text findings and anchored regions against the six preregistered locations and source image; grouped findings may cover more than one location.
supported: The candidate directly detects all six known clipped locations in one supplied original image when run by a vision-capable host. Baseline also detects these locations when actually viewing the image.
not_supported: Six independent defects or six independent scenarios
Autonomous runtime vision without a host
Browser clipping cause established from this Figma screenshot
Figma fidelity or full product completion from a screenshot-only run
